title: 第21章 兵入秘境第22章 团队配合
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
钟教头的灵气之说，核心就一个词‘供需’。
越强的武者需要的灵气越多，没有足够的灵气供给，普通的物资根本养不活强横武者。
周元从中看到了集中主义，大量的资源向武者们倾斜，向上形成财与力结合的超凡阶层，向下延伸出把持地方的门阀世家。
这是一种超凡者统治普通人的特殊模式。
表面上看类似蓝星古代时期，本质却是普通人没有反抗能力，王朝更替与否，皆由超凡武者决定。
周元不认为这些问题离自己很远，他已经进入了大魏军营，早晚要面对出身的限制。
他想的没错，钟教头将他送到神臂队内堂时，神臂队成员虽然对新人到来表示欢迎，但也问起了出身问题。
“兄弟，开几石弓？”
“三石。”
“箭能准否？”
“静射可百发皆中，动射十中**。”
“大善，好郎君，是何出身？”
“良家农户。”
“倒是低了，你这份本事可入不得良家，努力杀敌吧，若能毙敌百余，自能得个官身补益。”
神臂队的成员最低是队正军职，更多的是都伯军职。
可以说这里大多数是官、而非卒，好在他们大都是通过厮杀上位的，虽然看重出身，但也重视本领。
否则周元还真融入不了，一个军官比士卒还多的队伍。
他一边与身旁的前辈交谈，一边观察内堂的神臂队成员。
这些人的血条全部残缺，最高的有93%，最低的为86%。
武器大都装备两把弓，从弓体结构上看，一把为二石步弓、一把为三石硬弓。

副武器方面为长短两柄刀，盔甲护具以半身甲为主，竟然比射声营的负重还低。
“吴哥，咱们这披甲是不是有什么讲究，怎么甲防不增反减。”
“这事儿你莫和我们学，我们都是老兵，常出入秘境厮杀，有了自己的战斗风格。
你刚加入稳妥为主，不过我可以给你一个建议，你最好再带一把能够速射的弓。
这秘境中的妖魔与人一样有强有弱，三石弓久持费力，二石弓刚好堪用。”
“多谢吴哥教导，我用不用练习什么队形。”
“不用，等进入秘境你就知道了，玄甲队的乌龟才需要队形，我们啊射得准、学会躲就行了。”
周元从善如流选了一把二石弓带上，并学着老兵的样子在箭壶中放了破甲箭与锥头箭。
“上弦啊，愣着干啥，你是新人你先上，见见血让大家看看你的成色。”
由于弓身常绷容易掉力，营中规定战弓不用时必须下弦保养，因此周元的三石硬弓并没有上弦。
他原以为自己刚到，就算不接受相关训练，也该有观战之类的待遇。
没想到老兵欢迎新人的方式如此特殊，不练不看，直接丢秘境厮杀去。
“咱们这都这么直接吗，我还以为要先接受训练，再评估能不能留下。”
“训练？你没训练好来这作甚，世家子才有训练的机会，良家子有机会就得干。
否则等你训练完了，哪还有实惠可吃。”
宽敞的内堂中，众射手忙着给弓上弦、检查箭支质量、调整盔甲松紧度。
此刻，这里不像是室内休息场所，更像是一处随时准备厮杀的营地。
“咚、咚、咚···”
随着一阵鼓声响起，众射手陆续出走，经过周元身边时，还不忘说上一句‘出兵了，快跟上’。
content_en:
The core of Professor Zhong’s theory of aura is ‘supply and demand’.
The stronger the warrior, the more spiritual energy he needs. Without enough spiritual energy supply, ordinary materials cannot support the powerful warrior.
Zhou Yuan saw centralism in this. A large amount of resources were tilted towards warriors, forming an extraordinary class that combined wealth and power upwards, and extending downwards to the powerful families that controlled the place.
This is a special mode of extraordinary beings dominating ordinary people.
On the surface, it looks similar to the ancient era of Blue Star, but the essence is that ordinary people have no ability to resist, and whether the dynasty changes or not is decided by extraordinary warriors.
Zhou Yuan did not think that these problems were far away from him. He had already entered the Wei military camp and would have to face the restrictions of his origin sooner or later.
He was right. When Coach Zhong sent him to the inner hall of the Divine Arm Team, although the members of the Divine Arm Team welcomed the new arrival, they also asked about his background.
"Brother, how many stone bows can you fire?"
"Three stones."
"Is the arrow accurate?"
"You can hit a hundred hits with a static shot, and you can hit 10 hits with a dynamic shot."
"Great, good husband, where is your origin?"
"Good farmer."
"It's too low. With your skills, you won't be able to get into a good family. Try your best to kill the enemy. If you can kill more than a hundred enemies, you will be rewarded with an official career."
The members of the Divine Arm Team have at least the rank of captain, and more have the rank of Dub.
It can be said that most of the people here are officials, not soldiers. Fortunately, most of them rose to the top through fighting. Although they value their origins, they also value their abilities.
Otherwise, Zhou Yuan really wouldn't be able to integrate into a team with more officers than soldiers.
While talking to the seniors beside him, he observed the members of the Divine Arm Team in the inner hall.
The health bars of these people were all incomplete, with the highest being 93% and the lowest being 86%.
Most weapons are equipped with two bows. Judging from the structure of the bow body, one is a two-stone walking bow and the other is a three-stone hard bow.
The secondary weapons include long and short knives, and the armor and protective equipment are mainly half-body armor, which is actually lower than the weight of the Shesheng Battalion.
"Brother Angkor, is there something special about our armor? Why does our armor decrease instead of increasing?"
"Don't learn from us in this matter. We are all veterans. We often go to secret realms to fight, and we have our own fighting style.
You have just joined and it is important to be safe, but I can give you a suggestion. You'd better bring a bow that can shoot quickly.
The demons in this secret realm are as strong and weak as humans. The three-stone bow is long-lasting and laborious, but the two-stone bow is just right. "
"Thank you Angkor for teaching me. I don't need to practice any formations."
"No, you will know when you enter the secret realm. Only the turtles of Team Xuanjia need to form a formation. We can shoot accurately and learn to hide."
Zhou Yuan chose a two-stone bow from Shan Ruliu and put armor-piercing arrows and cone-head arrows in the arrow pot like a veteran.
"Win it up, what are you doing standing there in a daze? You're a newbie, go ahead and get some blood and let everyone see how good you are."
Since the bow body is easily stretched when it is constantly stretched, the camp stipulates that war bows must be unstrung for maintenance when not in use, so Zhou Yuan's three-stone hard bow was not strung up.
He originally thought that since he had just arrived, even if he did not receive relevant training, he should be treated like watching the battle.
I didn't expect that the veteran's way of welcoming newcomers was so special. If you don't practice and don't watch, you will just go to the secret realm to fight.
"Are we all so straightforward? I thought we had to undergo training first and then evaluate whether we can stay."
"Training? Why are you here if you haven't trained well? Only sons from aristocratic families have the opportunity to train, and sons from good families have to do it when they have the opportunity.
Otherwise, when you finish training, there will be no benefits left. "
In the spacious inner hall, the archers were busy stringing their bows, checking the quality of their arrows, and adjusting the tightness of their armor.
At this moment, this place does not look like an indoor resting place, but more like a camp ready to fight at any time.
"Dong, dong, dong..."
As a burst of drums sounded, the archers left one after another. When they passed by Zhou Yuan, they did not forget to say, "troops are being sent out, follow them quickly."
